1995 first feature — Andy's toys learn they are toys.

How Toy Story connects

  • Topic: Pixar — Toy Story is Pixar's first feature.
  • Creator: John Lasseter — Lasseter directed Toy Story.
  • Character: Woody — Toy Story is Woody's first film as Andy's favorite.
  • Character: Buzz Lightyear — Toy Story is the film that introduces Buzz to Andy's room.
  • Faction: Andy's toys — Andy's toys are the ensemble Toy Story is about.

What is Toy Story?

Toy Story is the first fully computer-animated feature, following Woody, Buzz, and Andy's toys when a space-ranger delusion collides with a cowboy's place on the bed.

Key threads lead to Pixar, John Lasseter, Woody, Buzz Lightyear and Andy's toys.
